notes.title: Monochrome World Patch Notes - 7/3/2020
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Overall adjustment on the pause UI.
[*]Fixed the issue that occurs during the in-game event in stage 60.
[*]Fixed the issue with the character turning black after seeing the credits.
[*]Fixed the issue with the stage select screen blinking after the credits.
[/list]
We will make every effort with bugs and updates to make your "Monochrome World" experience comfortable and fun.
Our gratitude never stops. We will keep doing our best to meet your expectations.

notes.title: Monochrome World Patch Notes - 5/20/2020
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue related to Steam achievements.
[*]Corrected mistranslations.
[*]Adjusted sound effects of some objects.
[*]Improvements on flying enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue related to enemies in the sky.
[*]Made sure some background music are played properly.
[*]Adjustments on the options menu.
[*]Number of lives is correctly displayed in the stage screen.
[*]Fixed an issue related to not being able to reset after falling off from the stage.
[/list]
We will do our best about fixing bugs and reacting feedback to make you play comfortable "Monochrome World". 
Our gratitude never stops. We will keep doing our best to meet your expectations.
